title: The optimal multiplicative MMS guarantee for chores
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: What is the smallest universal factor α≥1 such that every nonnegative additive chore instance admits a complete allocation giving each agent cost at most α times her minimax share?
context:
For chores the share is the minimum, over n-way partitions, of the largest bundle cost. Do not reverse the inequality or reuse the goods-MMS definition.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Seeks the intrinsic loss required for fair allocation of indivisible burdens.
